Negative retained earnings of -12,237M suggest significant cumulative losses, eroding equity, and high leverage (liabilities-to-equity ratio of approximately 3.4) amplifies solvency concerns despite a positive EBIT margin around 41%. Considering historical knowledge predating the year, such persistent issues typically place firms in highly speculative, high-risk categories. Based on this, the issuer falls into the CCC range due to the urgent vulnerability and reliance on favorable conditions to meet obligations.

DECISION: CCC
